articles.headline: Why American brands are losing relevance in China
articles.summary: Chinese consumers are turning away from American brands, from fashion to technology to cars. Experts say many companies have lost cultural relevance there, while domestic brands have innovated. Many shoppers also don’t think American prices are worth it, and geopolitical tensions have only increased shoppers’ willingness to buy from China. CNBC’s Laya Neelakandan has more on this growing trend.
